body.zh-Hant: 內爾高起初學神學，隨即轉向宗教史，1879年取得碩士資格，專攻古代猶太史。他1884年創辦《Tilskueren》刊物；1887年在納斯科夫（Nakskov）選區當選，任期三年，1892年再度當選丹麥國會（Folketing）議員。
body.en: Neergaard began with theology but quickly switched to the history of religion, and took his master's degree in 1879 with a specialty in ancient Jewish history. He founded the journal Tilskueren in 1884, was elected in the Nakskov constituency in 1887 for the following three years, and was elected to the Folketing again in 1892.

han 1884 grundlagde tidsskriftet Tilskueren
1887 blev han opstillet og valgt i Nakskov-kredsen for de følgende tre år
1892 valgtes han igen til folketinget

body.zh-Hant: 他先被任命為財政部長，試圖穩住搖搖欲墜的內閣；1908年9月P. A. Alberti垮台，也使內閣崩潰，內爾高被稱為當時唯一毫無污點的部長，藉著局勢成為新的首相（konseilspræsident），並兼任國防部長。
body.en: He was first made finance minister in an attempt to prop up a wavering ministry. P. A. Alberti's collapse in September 1908 brought the government down too; Neergaard, described as the only entirely unstained minister, became the new konseilspræsident (prime minister) and also took the defence portfolio.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年復活節危機後，內爾高在J. C. Christensen推辭下接任首相；他在1920年夏天完成重新統一（genforeningen），並於7月11日在迪博爾（Dybbøl）發表著名演說。1920至1924年任首相期間他同時兼任財政部長；任內因戰後經濟危機與1922年Landmandsbanken倒閉而動盪。
body.en: After the Easter Crisis of 1920 Neergaard became prime minister because J. C. Christensen declined the post, and in summer 1920 he saw the reunification (genforeningen) through, giving his famous Dybbøl speech on 11 July. During his 1920–24 premiership he was also finance minister; his term was turbulent because of the post-war economic crises and the collapse of the Landmandsbank in summer 1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 其他任期的財政部長職務

body.zh-Hant: 1910至1913年，內爾高在貝恩特森（Klaus Berntsen）政府任財政部長；1926至1929年他在Madsen-Mygdal政府再度出任財政部長，這是他第五度主掌財政部，並於1929年4月隨其餘閣員離任。
body.en: In 1910–1913 Neergaard was finance minister in the Berntsen government. In 1926–1929 he was finance minister again in the Madsen-Mygdal government, the fifth time he held the finance ministry, and he left office with the rest of the government in April 1929.

body.zh-Hant: 羅德里格斯出身索諾拉州瓜伊馬斯的清寒家庭，受教育不多，做過許多無技術工作，1913年加入立憲派，從軍後一路晉升，1928年成為師長級將領（三星）。1923至1929年他任下加利福尼亞北部的省長兼軍事指揮官，並利用此職發展個人的漁業與包裝業投資。
body.en: Rodríguez came from a humble family in Guaymas, Sonora, with little formal education, and worked many unskilled jobs before joining the Constitutionalists in 1913. He made the military his career, reaching division general (three stars) in 1928. He was governor and military commander of Baja California del Norte in 1923–1929, a post he used to build up personal holdings in fishing and packing.

body.zh-Hant: 1932年他歷任工商部長與戰爭暨海軍部長；他接替辭職的帕斯誇爾·奧爾蒂斯·魯維奧（Pascual Ortiz Rubio），成為1932至1934年的墨西哥總統，是1928至1934年間三位總統中的最後一位。評價上他通常被視為看守性質的總統，聽命於導師普魯塔爾科·埃利亞斯·卡列斯（Plutarco Elías Calles）。
body.en: In 1932 he held cabinet posts including secretary of industry and commerce and secretary of war and the navy. He replaced Pascual Ortiz Rubio when the latter resigned and was president of Mexico in 1932–1934, the last of the troika of presidents of the 1928–1934 administration. He is generally considered a caretaker subordinate to his mentor, General Plutarco Elías Calles.

people.name: Manuel Márquez Sterling
people.nameZh: 曼努埃爾·馬克斯·斯特林

heading.en: 1934: caretaker of the presidency and the treaty signing

body.zh-Hant: 1934年1月18日清晨，總統哈維亞（Hevia）離開總統府，把總統職位交到國務卿（Secretary of State）馬克斯·斯特林手上，由他召集各政治團體代表開會，選出新總統；當天卡洛斯·門迭塔（Mendieta）經指定為臨時總統，中午宣誓就職。2月12日他以古巴駐美大使身分致函美國國務卿；5月29日他在華盛頓代表古巴簽署與美國的《關係條約》。
body.en: On the morning of 18 January 1934, President Hevia left the Palace, leaving the presidency in the hands of the Secretary of State, Márquez Sterling, who was to convene representatives of all the political groups to elect a new president; Colonel Carlos Mendieta was designated Provisional President that day and took the oath at noon. On 12 February he wrote to the U.S. Secretary of State as Cuban Ambassador, and on 29 May 1934 he signed the Treaty of Relations with the United States at Washington as Cuba's plenipotentiary.

body.zh-Hant: 加里寧出生於特維爾省農民家庭，1889年遷往聖彼得堡，進入普提洛夫工廠工作；自1898年起活躍於俄國社會民主黨，成為老布爾什維克。1917年十月革命後，他出任彼得格勒的首席行政官。
body.en: Kalinin was born to peasant parents in Tver Province, moved to St. Petersburg in 1889 and found work at the Putilov factory. Active in the Russian Social Democratic Party from 1898, he was an Old Bolshevik. After the October Revolution in 1917 he became the chief administrator in Petrograd.

heading.zh-Hant: 1919年後的黨政職務與政治立場
heading.en: Party and state posts and political stance after 1919

body.zh-Hant: 1919年他擔任全俄中央執行委員會主席，同年起成為黨中央委員，1922年任蘇聯總統（此為來源用語），1925年成為政治局正式委員，1923年與1936年主持憲法起草委員會。列寧去世後的權力鬥爭中，他先與史達林聯手對抗托洛茨基與左翼反對派；史達林轉向強制集體化後，他與布哈林一同主張溫和。
body.en: He was chairman of the All-Russian Central Executive Committee in 1919 and a member of the party's Central Committee from 1919, president of the USSR in 1922 (the source's wording), and a full member of the Politburo from 1925; he chaired commissions that prepared the Soviet constitutions of 1923 and 1936. After Lenin's death he allied with Stalin against Trotsky and the Left Opposition, but when Stalin turned to forced collectivization he sided with Bukharin in advocating moderation.
